California's broad-based categorical eligibility (SNAP 200-percent-class
state option; PolicyEngine models gross screen x2 FPL, x2 for
elderly/disabled households, at 2026-01 per gov/hhs/tanf/non_cash
parameters) is not in the composed us-ca/snap/fy-2026 program, which
applies only the standard federal tests. Every selected row is verified
per-row against axiom's persisted output surface: the household passes
axiom's gross test and fails only the resource test, which the state's
BBCE waives. Axiom-side modeling boundary, tracked for encoding in
rulespec-us#1098.
